visual_response_bank_requirements.content: Bottom-view mark focus and two spots: separated, overlapping, unequal size or saturated
Single/dual-arm views of pencil beams, epifluorescence spots and sheet lines
Beads: single, aggregated, leading, lagging, scale mismatch or vibration
PSF reslices, lateral/axial profiles and sheet thickness at multiple field positions
Embryo/cell dual fields, sheet coverage, Z truncation and target drift
Reporter-sample preparation states: healthy, abnormal, signal present or absent
Raw A/B, aligned/misaligned overlays, temporal drift, reconstruction artifacts and resource warnings

before_static_build: resolve robot embodiment or choose explicitly authored generic reach model
choose and disclose sample-stage proxy while retaining source identity conflict
specify normalized scene coordinates separate from laboratory coordinates
create new geometry/images with provenance tags; do not export source pixels
instantiate manipulable subcomponents and clear affordances
define one observation-consistent preset response table per diagnostic family
before_physical_or_physics_execution: actual specimen stocks and local approvals

geometry_rules: source optical focal length is not housing length
source image scale bar is not microscope dimension
schematics marked not to scale cannot set robot trajectories
authored proxy dimensions must be labeled authored_proxy and never reported as manufacturer geometry
all source apparatus identities remain distinct from existing TiE/iXon assets
